items.text: OpenAI published an engineering deep dive on rebuilding its voice stack for GPT-Live, routing audio down a fast path and cutting session startup from six network round trips.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 发布工程详解，介绍如何为 GPT-Live 重构语音栈：音频走专用快速通道，推理与工具调用异步进行，语音会话启动从六次网络往返大幅压缩。

items.text: Microsoft Research open-sourced Orchard, a Kubernetes-based framework for training and evaluating agents, with its 3B-active-parameter Orchard-SWE hitting 69.7% on SWE-bench Verified.
items.text_zh: 微软研究院开源 Orchard 智能体训练与评测框架，基于轻量 Kubernetes 环境；其约 30 亿激活参数的 Orchard-SWE 在 SWE-bench Verified 上取得 69.7%。

items.text: Vercel launched the v0 API, giving developers programmatic app building: start a chat from a prompt, repo or ZIP, and render a dev-server preview.
items.text_zh: Vercel 推出 v0 API，开发者可通过编程方式调用其应用生成能力：从提示词、代码仓库或 ZIP 发起会话，并渲染开发服务器预览。

items.text: SenseTime open-sourced SenseNova U1.5-Lite-Preview, an 8B unified multimodal model that generates native 4K images and supports pixel-level editing, released on GitHub, Hugging Face and ModelScope.
items.text_zh: 商汤开源 SenseNova U1.5-Lite-Preview，8B 原生统一多模态模型，支持 4K 直出图像生成与像素级编辑，已上线 GitHub、Hugging Face 与魔搭。

items.text: The team behind Design Arena raised a $7.9 million seed led by Index Ventures to rank media-generating AI models on human taste judgments.
items.text_zh: Design Arena 团队完成 790 万美元种子轮融资，由 Index Ventures 领投，Conviction、A* 等跟投，以人类偏好对生成类 AI 模型的"审美"排名。

items.text: Cognition hired former Coinbase chief legal officer Paul Grewal, who stepped down on July 31, as its chief legal and global affairs officer.
items.text_zh: Devin 开发商 Cognition 宣布聘请前 Coinbase 首席法务官 Paul Grewal 出任首席法务与全球事务官，其于 7 月 31 日刚从 Coinbase 卸任。

items.text: ElevenLabs launched ElevenAgents for enterprises, saying over 10 million voice and chat agent conversations already run on the platform weekly with configurable guardrails and regional data residency.
items.text_zh: ElevenLabs 推出面向企业的 ElevenAgents，称平台每周已承载超过 1000 万次语音与文字客服对话，提供可配置护栏与区域数据驻留选项。

items.text: Meshy rolled out 8K texturing for its 3D generation platform, showcasing worn metal, plush and plastic materials rendered at production fidelity.
items.text_zh: 3D 生成平台 Meshy 上线 8K 贴图能力，展示做旧金属、绒布与塑料等材质的高保真渲染效果，向"可直接使用"的资产质量靠拢。

items.text: Kuaishou's Kling published a Kling MCP tutorial showing agents batch-producing food promo videos, from analyzing creative styles and building storyboards to generating final shots.
items.text_zh: 快手可灵发布 Kling MCP 教程，演示智能体批量生产美食推广视频：从分析创意风格、生成分镜脚本到成片输出全流程自动化。

items.text: Xiaoda Robotics and NTU's S-Lab open-sourced ACE-Data-0, an embodied dataset of 17 million frames across 200 task categories recorded in two real homes.
items.text_zh: 大晓机器人联合南洋理工 S-Lab 开源具身数据集 ACE-Data-0：1700 万帧视频、200 个任务类别，取自两个真实家庭环境，同步七种模态信号。

items.text: Interpol said AI has become the core operational driver of cybercrime across Africa, powering scams, fraud and impersonation at growing scale.
items.text_zh: 国际刑警组织表示，AI 已成为非洲网络犯罪的"核心运营驱动力"，被广泛用于诈骗、欺诈与身份冒充，规模持续扩大。

items.text: A US company's AI now lets Ukraine's low-cost kamikaze drones track targets autonomously, a step toward future swarm attacks.
items.text_zh: 一家美国公司的 AI 让乌克兰廉价自杀式无人机具备自主跟踪目标能力，被视为迈向未来蜂群攻击的一步。

items.text: An AI-supervised remote exam failed so badly that 58,000 students have been ordered to retake it, renewing scrutiny of automated proctoring.
items.text_zh: 一场由 AI 监考的远程考试出现严重故障，5.8 万名学生被要求重考，自动化监考技术的可靠性再度受到质疑。

items.text: MarkTechPost published a hands-on guide to evaluating multimodal vision models with Moonshot's PerceptionBench, using robust data loading and automated LLM judging.
items.text_zh: MarkTechPost 发布实操教程，讲解如何用月之暗面的 PerceptionBench 评测多模态视觉模型，涵盖稳健的数据加载与自动化裁判评分流程。

items.text: OpenAI countered Apple's trade-secret suit with iMessage logs showing Apple staff repeatedly texted a departed engineer for internal information, arguing Apple's own access controls failed.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 反击苹果商业机密诉讼，公布 iMessage 聊天记录，显示苹果员工在工程师离职后仍多次向其索要内部信息，称问题出在苹果自身的权限管理。

items.text: A Kansas mathematician refuted OpenAI's claimed disproof of the Connes rigidity conjecture within 24 hours, tracing 37,000 lines of Lean 4 to a group failing preconditions.
items.text_zh: 堪萨斯大学数学家在 24 小时内驳回 OpenAI 号称攻破 Connes 刚性猜想的证明：她逐行核对 3.7 万行 Lean 4 代码，发现构造的一个群不满足前提条件。

items.text: Y Combinator open-sourced QM under MIT, a multiplayer agent harness for Slack and web giving each person isolated memory, files, permissions and sandboxes.
items.text_zh: Y Combinator 以 MIT 协议开源多人协作智能体框架 QM，可在 Slack 与网页运行，为每位成员和房间提供隔离的记忆、文件、权限与沙箱环境。

items.text: A study of 414 internet-facing MCP servers found 68 reportable flaws and 91.8% lacking OAuth, plus 687 tools offering unrestricted shell execution.
items.text_zh: 一项针对 414 台公网 MCP 服务器的动态审计发现 68 个可上报漏洞，91.8% 未启用 OAuth 认证，另有 687 个工具实例可无限制执行 shell 命令。

items.text: Reflex open-sourced XY under Apache-2.0, a Rust-backed Python charting library holding ~0.08s renders from 10,000 to 100 million interactive points.
items.text_zh: Reflex 以 Apache-2.0 协议开源 Python 图表库 XY：Rust 后端加 WebGL2 渲染，从 1 万点到 1 亿点均保持约 0.08 秒渲染与可交互。

items.text: OpenAI's luxury Hudson Valley creator retreat drew backlash over $2,000-a-night rooms and farm activities, with several influencers deleting their posts afterwards.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 在纽约哈德逊河谷为内容创作者办的高端"夏令营"引发争议：每晚房费超 2000 美元、活动主打采蜜绘画等田园项目，多位网红事后删帖。

items.text: Om AI raised several hundred million yuan led by Qianhai Mother Fund for edge-native multimodal perception models, whose Homer AI serves nearly 100,000 visually impaired users.
items.text_zh: 端侧物理 AI 公司联汇科技完成数亿元融资，前海母基金领投、杭州政府产业基金等跟投；其 Homer AI 已服务近 10 万视障用户。

items.text: Palantir CEO Alex Karp called AI labs' enterprise ambitions "Marxist" after Q2 revenue hit $1.9 billion, up 93%, with $1.1 billion profit.
items.text_zh: Palantir 二季度营收 19 亿美元、同比增长 93%，利润 11 亿美元；CEO Alex Karp 在股东信中抨击前沿 AI 实验室企图垄断生产资料，称其带有"马克思主义色彩"。

items.text: Recraft showed V4.1 swapping an object's material while keeping its form intact, pitching editable physical logic rather than a freshly regenerated image.
items.text_zh: Recraft 展示 V4.1 的材质替换能力：在保持物体造型不变的前提下更换材质，强调这不是重新生成一张图，而是给同一设计换一套物理逻辑。

items.text: Sakana AI became a full member of Japan's AI Robot Association this month, collaborating on world models and physical AI research under its RSI Lab.
items.text_zh: Sakana AI 宣布本月成为日本 AI 机器人协会（AIRoA）正式会员，将在 RSI Lab 框架下与其合作推进世界模型与物理 AI 的研发。

items.text: MiniMax rebutted claims its H3 video model cannot be legally used in certain regions, saying it can be licensed for deployment in the US, EU, UK and South Korea.
items.text_zh: MiniMax 反驳"H3 视频模型在部分地区不能合法使用"的说法，称该模型可获授权在美国、欧盟、英国与韩国部署。

items.text: Together AI put DeepSeek V4 Flash into production, citing stronger terminal, repository and full-stack coding plus better tool use for long-running agents.
items.text_zh: Together AI 上线 DeepSeek V4 Flash 生产级推理服务，主打终端、代码仓库与全栈编码能力提升，以及面向长时运行智能体的更强工具调用。

items.text: MarkTechPost detailed a skill-auditing pipeline using NVIDIA SkillSpector and LangGraph to scan agent skills for shell injection, credential harvesting and MCP attacks before deployment.
items.text_zh: MarkTechPost 详解基于英伟达 SkillSpector 与 LangGraph 的智能体技能安全审计流水线，可在部署前检出 shell 注入、凭据窃取与 MCP 攻击，并输出 SARIF 报告卡关 CI。

items.text: PixVerse showed a rooftop-to-office scene built in PixVerse Canvas, saying the physics holds up down to a tote bag swinging correctly through the shot.
items.text_zh: PixVerse 展示用 PixVerse Canvas 制作的"天台到办公室"连贯镜头，称画面物理表现足够扎实，连手提袋的摆动都符合真实运动规律。
